query:
SELECT d.id
                FROM tensorzero.chat_inference_data d
                JOIN tensorzero.chat_inferences i ON i.id = d.id
                WHERE i.tags ? $1
                  AND ($2::TEXT IS NULL OR i.tags ->> $1 = $2)
                  AND i.protected_at IS NULL
                  AND d.created_at < $3
                  AND d.created_at < date_trunc('day', now())
